dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: Hey, who are you? You don't work here, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: This is Tenshukaku, the office of Inazuma's most important officials. Everyone here has a big job to do.

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: If you disturb anyone here, I will happily escort you away from the premises.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What big job are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: Reprimanding new recruits and fixing morale.

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: Young people these days are lazy. If no one is strict with them, the entire group becomes one big mess.

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: I need to let them know that serving as a guard of Tenshukaku is a precious honor not to be taken lightly!

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: What most people would give for an opportunity like this... They must discipline themselves and work hard to rise through the ranks, just like me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just like you?

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: Correct.

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: I wasn't born into this position as a military officer.

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: I came from nothing, relying on nothing but my own diligence and dedication to earn recognition from the old Hatamoto lord, gradually rising through the ranks from infantry to one of the Hatamoto forces.

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: The clan name I have the pleasure to humbly serve is a symbol of my pride!

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: My experience is evidence that if you work tirelessly, you will be successful.

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: If these new soldiers work as hard as I have, they too will eventually earn a place among the Hatamoto forces!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: Hmph, you better understand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Making some preparations, are we?

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: Of course. I'm always looking to do something for the Shogunate.

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: Word on the street is that the fog over Tsurumi Island's gone, and that people might be sent there. The way I see it, the new troops need more training now than ever before!

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: I mean, we can't have them panicking the moment there's a whiff on danger in the air there! That would be an embarrassment!
